contexts.name: project.info
contexts.description: Project metadata: name, path, Unity version, and overall project structure.

contexts.name: project.tags
contexts.description: List all tags defined in the project's Tag Manager.

contexts.name: project.layers
contexts.description: List all layers defined in the project's Tag Manager.

contexts.name: editor.state
contexts.description: Read-only snapshot of current Unity Editor state: Play Mode, compile/import/build busy flags, active scene, Prefab Stage, Bridge build stamp, and runtime session status. Use this before live tools to avoid acting while Unity is busy.

contexts.name: editor.selection
contexts.description: Read the current Unity Editor selection in Hierarchy or Project Browser. Returns legacy name arrays plus reusable object details: instanceId, type, asset path/GUID, hierarchy path, GameObject reference, transform, and component summaries. It does not select, focus, ping, or modify anything.

contexts.name: editor.active-tool
contexts.description: Read the currently active Unity Editor transform/tool handle plus pivot mode, pivot rotation, handle position, and handle rotation. Does not change the active tool.

contexts.name: editor.windows
contexts.description: Read currently open Unity EditorWindow instances with title, type names, focused state, and instance IDs. This observes editor UI state without opening, closing, focusing, or moving windows.

contexts.name: editor.tool-states
contexts.description: Read Unity Editor transform tool settings, pivot mode/rotation, snap settings, and grid availability. This is not MCP tool discovery; it observes editor tool configuration only.

contexts.name: prefab.stage
contexts.description: Current Prefab Mode / Prefab Stage state if a prefab is being edited.

contexts.name: editor.menu-items
contexts.description: Attempt to enumerate Unity Editor menu items as read-only discovery. Unity has no stable public API for full menu enumeration, so this context may return an empty `items` array with diagnostics; executing a menu path remains the destructive Tool `editor.menu`.

contexts.name: scene.gameobject
contexts.description: Read one GameObject's lightweight scene summary by id, hierarchy path, or name. Use this before go.inspect, component.get, object.get-data, or mutation tools to confirm the stable path/id. Does not modify the scene; for full component fields use component.get.

contexts.name: scene.gameobject.components
contexts.description: Lightweight list of components attached to a GameObject: type names, enabled state and optional readable property preview. Use this before component.get/component.modify to choose component name or index. Does NOT return full fields/props; for deep component data use `tools run component.get`.

contexts.name: scene.gameobject.component
contexts.description: Lightweight preview of one component attached to a GameObject. Use scene.gameobject.components first when unsure which component name exists. Does NOT replace deep reads; for complete fields/props use `tools run component.get`.

contexts.name: scene.opened
contexts.description: List currently loaded scenes in the Editor with name, path, build index, loaded state, dirty state, and active scene. Read-only; does not load, unload, save, or switch scenes.

contexts.name: scene.cameras
contexts.description: List all active scene cameras with stable GameObject path, tag, enabled state, projection, FOV/orthographic size, depth, target texture, and pixel size. Read-only camera inventory.

contexts.name: scene.volumes
contexts.description: List Volume components in the active scene with target GameObject, enabled state, global flag, priority, weight, profile reference, and pagination metadata. Returns an empty list when Volume type is unavailable.

contexts.name: scene.renderer-features
contexts.description: Read URP renderer feature availability and configured feature names for the active/default render pipeline. If URP or a pipeline asset is unavailable, returns available=false with diagnostics and nextActions.

contexts.name: scene.rendering-stats
contexts.description: Read current rendering statistics from UnityStats when available. If Unity's internal stats API is unavailable, returns available=false with diagnostics and nextActions.

contexts.name: prefab.info
contexts.description: Read Prefab asset metadata, dependencies, variant information, and nested prefab references.

contexts.name: prefab.hierarchy
contexts.description: Read a Prefab's hierarchy without opening or modifying the Prefab Stage.

contexts.name: tests.list
contexts.description: List all test fixtures and test methods in the project.

contexts.name: tools.groups
contexts.description: Read built-in and available extension tool groups with counts and discovery commands from the local CLI registry; no Unity connection is required.

contexts.name: tools.custom
contexts.description: Read custom Unity project IUnityCliTool descriptors discovered through the live Bridge.
